periods.analysis: Permit applications for the Phase 3 arterial survey segments were submitted to Traffic Engineering in June and are pending review. This is the sole critical-path dependency for the July 1 survey start; residential segments can proceed without it. Recommend confirming approval status by June 27 and, if the review is still open, requesting a conditional lane-closure authorization for the first two arterial segments so mobilization is not delayed.

Phase 3 traffic-control permits confirmed with the Transportation Division on 9/4. Lane-closure windows approved for the Maple St corridor weekdays 9:00–15:00 through 10/31. Survey crews remobilized 9/8. Copies filed to the Phase 3 project folder.
